route_decision.rationale: Keep the test local and dependency-free: parse PDF page-tree Count and every leaf MediaBox in JS without Poppler; do not request third-party install or change Shared printer.

options_not_selected.A: requires explicit Owner Poppler-install approval; unnecessary
options_not_selected.C: A4 NOT_RUN remains until code executes, but technical dependency now removed

delta: Removed execFileSync pdfinfo invocation; retained npm root -g Playwright resolution
Read PDF Buffer latin1 and require PDF header and EOF
Walk catalog /Pages /Kids tree, verify /Parent, reject repeated/cyclic/unknown nodes and inconsistent /Count
Count all leaf /Page objects and validate every leaf MediaBox, incl. inherited box; reject invalid or rotated page
Check all page boxes match portrait A4 geometry within 1.5pt and emit method marker in sanitized receipt
Fail closed as PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_UNAVAILABLE if Chromium cannot launch; verify geometry before private PDF write

next: Coordinator run exact one-line local Node A4 audit on existing original Core1A native SHA; return sanitized first blocker or only source-safe-a4-audit-receipt.json. If passes geometry, still needs Owner visual legibility/page-break judgement and separate production PDF policy/rights decisions.
